title: Lead Engineer - React Native
jobDescription:
Job Description: Senior React Native Developer (6 to 8 Years Experience)

Position Title

Senior React Native Developer

Experience Required

6 to 8 Years

Location

Pune/Bengaluru (Onsite)

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior React Native Developer with 4-6 years of experience in mobile application development. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in building scalable, high-performance cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for Android and iOS platforms. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining mobile applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional user experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain mobile applications using React Native.
  • Build reusable, modular, and scalable components following industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Engineers, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party SDKs.
  • Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and reliability across Android and iOS devices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, crashes, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Implement security and data protection best practices in mobile applications.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers.
  • Create and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end automation tests.
  • Manage application deployment processes for Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
  • Stay updated with emerging mobile technologies, React Native updates, and industry trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 4-6 years of experience in software development with at least 3+ years of hands-on experience in React Native.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Experience with React Hooks, Context API, Redux, Redux Toolkit.
  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture and design patterns.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and handling JSON data.
  • Knowledge of Android and iOS platform-specific implementations.
  • Experience with Git, Bitbucket and modern version control workflows.
  • Familiarity with React Navigation and deep linking.
  • Experience with mobile analytics and crash reporting tools such as Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, MoEngage, AppsFlyer, or Dynatrace.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks such as Jest and React Native Testing Library.
  • Familiarity with E2E testing tools like Detox or Appium.

Mobile Development Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, state management, and memory optimization.
  • Experience with native Android (Java/Kotlin) and iOS (Swift/Objective-C) integrations.
  • Knowledge of push notifications, deep links, and app permissions.
  • Understanding of mobile security best practices and app store deployment processes.
  • Experience with offline storage solutions such as AsyncStorage, MMKV, or SQLite.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with React Native New Architecture (Fabric & TurboModules).
  • Experience with CodePush or OTA update mechanisms.
  • Familiarity with Firebase services and cloud integrations.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and responsive/mobile-first design principles.
  • Experience in large-scale consumer-facing mobile applications.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead technical initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration and mentoring mindset.
  • Ownership-driven approach with a focus on quality and timely delivery.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale mobile applications.
  • Exposure to modern technologies and architecture patterns.
  • Collaborative and innovation-driven work culture.
  • Professional growth and leadership opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Location

Bengaluru (Atlantis)

Experience

3–5 years in Property & Engineering insurance

Employment

Full-time

Role Summary

The Product Champion will own and centrally drive the Property & Engineering line of business across Digit’s agency and retail broking sales network. Acting as the single point of expertise for the LOB, this person will be the bridge between the field sales teams and underwriting — clarifying guidelines, communicating sales strategy, and championing doable risks back to underwriting with sound technical logic. The goal: faster, sharper, more confident P&E selling across the country.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the LOB centrally

• Own the P&E LOB agenda for the central sales team and translate product strategy into actionable field guidance.

• Track LOB performance, identify gaps and opportunities, and drive corrective action with sales and underwriting.

Enable & support the sales network

• Be the go-to resource for all internal sales colleagues on P&E — resolving doubts on product guidelines, coverage, and risk acceptance criteria.

• Communicate and embed sales strategy, campaigns, and priorities across the network clearly and consistently.

• Build sales capability through training, ready-reckoners, FAQs, and on-call support.

Champion risk acceptance with underwriting

• Review risks declined by underwriting, assess viability, and make a reasoned case to UW for reconsideration of doable risks — backed by data and technical logic.

• Coordinate closely with underwriters to expand acceptable risk appetite where commercially sound, and to align field expectations with UW guidelines.

• Act as an honest broker between sales urgency and underwriting prudence.

Feedback loop & continuous improvement

• Capture recurring field issues and market feedback; feed them into product and underwriting for guideline refinement.

• Keep sales teams updated on changes to guidelines, risk acceptance norms, and appetite.

Must-Have Skills

• Working knowledge of the rating structures applicable to both Property and Engineering products — able to quickly dissect pricing and frame a precise, well-justified discount ask to underwriting, rather than leaving it for the UW to work out.

• 3–5 years of experience in Property & Engineering insurance, with hands-on underwriting background in the LOB.

• In-depth understanding of P&E products, coverages, rating, and risk acceptance guidelines.

• Strong grasp of underwriting logic — able to credibly engage and influence underwriters.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; comfortable working across sales and underwriting.

Preferred

• MBA (Sales/Marketing/Strategy or General Management).

• Exposure to agency/retail broking distribution.

Key Competencies:

Technical product authority • Sales enablement • Analytical & data-driven reasoning • Collaboration • Ownership

title: Cluster Head
jobDescription:
Role Title: Cluster Head – Banca Channel
Function: Sales – Banca
Reporting To: SBH / Zonal Banca Head
Location: As per cluster allocation
The Cluster Head – Banca Channel is responsible for leading the banca business for an assigned cluster by driving RM performance, productivity, market share growth, and disciplined execution across all products. The role ensures cluster‑level premium delivery, portfolio quality, and strong partner relationships, while building a high‑accountability RM team.
Key Responsibilities
Cluster Business & Premium Delivery
  • Own and deliver cluster issued premium vs targets through RM performance and direct ownership of mid‑sized ticket issuances.
  • Forecast business performance and take timely corrective actions to close delivery gaps.
RM Planning, Productivity & Performance Management
  • Plan and allocate RMs effectively, ensuring RM span of control is within prescribed limits.
  • Track RM‑level productivity, conversion, and threshold performance.
  • Improve the share of RMs crossing threshold performance and qualifying for incentives.
  • Identify and intervene early on low performers.
  • Hire, train, coach, and groom RMs through regular reviews and joint branch visits.
  • Drive rewards & recognition within the cluster, ensuring 60%+ RMs qualify for incentives.
Branch Coverage & Market Share Growth
  • Drive active branch coverage, ensuring the required % of branches contribute every month.
  • Reactivate dormant branches and improve consistency across the cluster.
  • Grow Digit’s market share in key branches and priority accounts by increasing penetration and share of wallet.
Conversion & Opportunity Management
  • Improve aggregated RM quote‑to‑login conversion across the cluster.
  • Directly own and convert mid‑sized opportunities.
  • Identify early signs of conversion or productivity drop‑offs and act decisively.
Portfolio Quality & Profitability
  • Maintain portfolio ROE above minimum defined thresholds.
  • Ensure growth is driven by the right product and business mix to protect portfolio quality.
Partner & Stakeholder Management
  • Handle escalations with bank branches and partners promptly and professionally.
  • Ensure Digit is rated as a preferred / best partner in partner surveys and feedback.
  • Build strong working relationships with key banking stakeholders.
Experience & Skills Required
Experience
  • 6–10+ years of experience in Banca / Insurance Distribution / Financial Services sales.
  • Prior experience managing RM teams and multiple bank branches.
Technical & Functional Skills
  • Strong understanding of banca distribution models and RM‑led sales execution.
  • Working knowledge of issued premium, productivity metrics, conversion funnels, and basic ROE concepts.
  • Ability to independently manage and close mid‑sized ticket opportunities.
Behavioral Skills
  • Strong people management and coaching capability.
  • High ownership and execution discipline.
  • Stakeholder management and escalation handling.
  • Comfort with dashboards, KPIs, and data‑driven reviews.
Qualifications
  • Graduate in any discipline; MBA / Postgraduate qualification preferred.
What You Bring to Digit
  • High and consistent revenue generation across every branch in the cluster.
  • Strong channel profitability driven by quality business.
  • Disciplined, productive RM teams with improving threshold performance.
  • Capability to expand banca presence into additional branches successfully.

title: Assessor In-House | Motor Claims
jobDescription:
Internal Surveyor – Motor Claims: Ensuring Accurate Assessment & Efficient Claims Processing


Company: Go Digit General Insurance

Department: Motor Claims – Survey & Assessment


Position Overview:

As an Internal Surveyor, you will be responsible for surveying and assessing claim applications, determining the genuineness of claims, and preparing detailed reports on losses. Your role ensures that damaged vehicles are surveyed efficiently, customer escalations are resolved, and outstanding claims are periodically reviewed for speedy disposal.


Key Responsibilities:

Survey & Assessment of Claims:

  • Conduct thorough assessments of claim applications to determine losses.

  • Prepare reports verifying the genuineness of claims while ensuring damaged vehicles are properly surveyed.

Claims Processing & Settlement:

  • Process and settle claims in accordance with company policies and guidelines.

  • Follow up on outstanding claims to ensure timely closure.

Customer & Channel Escalation Handling:

  • Address escalations from customers and business channels effectively, ensuring swift resolutions.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Work closely with external vendors within specified turnaround times.

  • Collaborate with law enforcement officials, eyewitnesses, and lawyers when required.

  • Maintain strong relationships with workshops and dealers to ensure seamless claim execution.

Turnaround Time (TAT) & Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to TAT across all assessment and claim processes as per defined SOPs.


Requirements:

  • Workshop background or prior experience in general insurance is preferable.

  • Diploma, BE, or BTech in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering.


Technical & Behavioral Skills:

Team Collaboration:

  • Ability to work effectively within a team and contribute to collective success.

Negotiation & Decision-Making:

  • Strong negotiation skills for handling claims and stakeholder discussions.

Communication & Analytical Thinking:

  • Clear and confident communication skills to interact with various parties involved in claim assessments.


Why This Role Matters:

Ensuring fair and accurate claims assessment is crucial in maintaining transparency and trust in insurance operations. Your expertise in surveys and risk analysis will contribute to efficient claim settlements and overall business integrity.


Ready to Join?

Step into a role where your assessment skills and problem-solving ability will drive impactful decisions in motor claims!
